title: Core Model Architectures
summary: This module provides a comprehensive collection of diverse model architectures, categorized by their primary domain or task, including causal language models, multimodal models, object detection, speech processing, and more.

nodes.label: Causal Language Models
nodes.title: Causal Language Models
nodes.description: Large language models designed for generative text tasks, predicting the next token in a sequence.

nodes.label: Vision Detection & Segmentation
nodes.title: Vision Detection & Segmentation
nodes.description: Models for identifying objects, their locations, and delineating regions within images and videos.

nodes.label: Text QA & Classification
nodes.title: Text QA & Classification
nodes.description: Models focused on understanding text to answer questions, categorize content, or perform token-level annotations.

nodes.label: Multimodal Integration
nodes.title: Multimodal Integration
nodes.description: Models combining multiple input modalities, such as vision, text, and audio, for joint understanding and generation tasks.

nodes.label: Speech & Audio Processing
nodes.title: Speech & Audio Processing
nodes.description: Models dedicated to processing, understanding, and generating speech and other audio signals.

nodes.label: Time Series Forecasting
nodes.title: Time Series Forecasting
nodes.description: Models specialized in analyzing and predicting patterns in sequential data over time.

nodes.label: Protein Sequence & Structure
nodes.title: Protein Sequence & Structure
nodes.description: Models for analyzing protein sequences, predicting structural properties, and understanding biological functions.

nodes.label: General Encoder-Decoder
nodes.title: General Encoder-Decoder Architectures
nodes.description: Foundational encoder-decoder architectures used for various sequence-to-sequence tasks like translation and conditional generation.

groups.label: Language Focused Models
groups.title: Language Focused Models

groups.title: Vision Focused Models

groups.label: Cross-Modal Models
groups.title: Cross-Modal Models

groups.label: Audio Focused Models
groups.title: Audio Focused Models

groups.label: Specialized Domain Models
groups.title: Specialized Domain Models
